#!/bin/bash

# Función para reemplazar patrones en un archivo
fix_layout\(\) {
    local file="$1"
    
    # Reemplazar Theme::partial con @include
    sed -i "s/{!! Theme::partial\('\\\([^']*\\\)'\) !!}/@include\('template::partials.\\1'\)/g" "$file"
    
    # Reemplazar Theme::content\(\) con @yield\('content'\)
    sed -i 's/{!! Theme::content\(\) !!}/@yield\("content"\)/g' "$file"
    
    # Remover condicionales Theme::get
    sed -i '/@if \(Theme::get/,/@endif/d' "$file"
    
    # Remover Theme::asset calls
    sed -i '/@php/,/@endphp/d' "$file"
}

# Procesar todos los layouts
for layout in platform/themes/wowy/layouts/*.blade.php; do
    fix_layout "$layout"
    echo "✓ Fixed: $\(basename $layout\)"
done
BASHEOF)
